# Story Hour Academy

> Story Hour Academy is a free, self-paced reading curriculum that teaches phonics and beginning reading skills to children through 112 online lessons. Built on structured literacy principles and the Science of Reading, it includes video instruction, interactive exercises, decodable reading materials, classic literature selections, pretests, and mastery tests. The curriculum covers phonograms, handwriting, consonants, vowels, digraphs, syllable types, and more.

- [Tests](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/tests): Pretests for diagnostic assessment and mastery tests for progress checks
- [Book List](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/book-list): Classic literature selections used throughout the curriculum

## Units

- [Unit 1: Single-Sound Consonants](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-1): Letters b, d, f, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, t, v, w, z
- [Unit 2: Consonant Digraphs](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-2): Phonograms ch, ck, ng, sh, th, wh
- [Unit 3: Multi-Letter Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-3): Phonograms like ai, ay, ar, ee, oa, oi, or, and more
- [Unit 4: Vowel Letters](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-4): The vowel letters a, e, i, o, u, y and their sounds
- [Unit 5: Multi-Sound Consonant Letters](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-5): Letters c, g, s, x and their multiple sounds
- [Unit 6: Syllable Types](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-6): Closed, open, vowel-consonant-e, vowel team, r-controlled, consonant-le
- [Unit 7: The Schwa Sound](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-7): Understanding the schwa vowel sound
- [Unit 8: More Single-Sound Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-8): Additional phonograms like dg, ph, gh, gn, kn, wr
- [Unit 9: More Multi-Sound Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-9): Advanced phonograms including ea, ew, oo, ou, ow
